rationale: B wins because it finds the sharper reporter door: "The hard part of a circular sneaker is the mail" turns this from a sustainability announcement into a reverse-logistics story with a real failure mode. A has good bones, but "Whether Runners Will Actually Return Them" drifts toward consumer-behavior mush and even leans on an unsupported claim about mail-back programs. B is less in love with the brand thesis and more useful to the founder trying to decide who can actually write this.
gaps_in_A: "Consumer mail-back programs in other categories have historically struggled with low return rates" is not in the update. If that context matters, it needs a cited benchmark, not hand-waving.

"A consumer behavior reporter or a fitness and running lifestyle journalist" is the weakest beat call in the set. The sharper version is supply-chain or reverse-logistics, because the story is whether the loop works, not whether runners feel virtuous.

"The investor angle ... has the strongest independent legs" oversells it. With no monthly price, no unit economics, and no recycling rate, a markets reporter has a skepticism piece, not a clean business-model story.

"Whether the circular economy has found a scalable business model in physical consumer goods" inflates one nationwide shoe subscription into a grand category verdict. That is how brand journalism puts on a fake mustache.
gaps_in_B: "A major athletic brand is moving a core product from purchase to subscription nationwide" overclaims "core product." The update says Cyclon is a running shoe going nationwide, not that On is converting a core line.
"Take-back programs are widely seen as the operational graveyard of circular retail" is a great line with no sourcing in the fact block. Keep the tension, but prove it or phrase it as a question.

"The gap between lab-stage bio-materials and products at retail scale" risks implying the material was lab-stage before. The supplied fact is narrower: a castor-bean-based shoe moved from limited pilot to nationwide subscription.
